name: git (devcontainer wrapper and setup)
description: Augments whichever git the image already has (base image, common-utils or ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/git) for devcontainers whose checkout keeps its git dir outside the workspace: with one bind mount of the host's .git-dirs folder at /git-dirs (GIT_DIRS_ROOT), a /usr/local/bin/git wrapper maps a checkout's .git pointer holding a host path under .git-dirs (C:/Users/<user>/.git-dirs/<owner>/<repo>) onto that mount for each call, so no repo declares GIT_DIR; with GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE in containerEnv (the per-repo form, still supported) it drops those two variables inside linked worktrees (Claude Code's .claude/worktrees/<name>) and nested repositories, so they are not sent to the main checkout, and puts the real values back when Claude Code replaces GIT_DIR with a not-a-git-repository placeholder, and a postCreateCommand hook (git-setup) does the per-container setup every repo otherwise scripts by hand - the git dir mapping recorded, safe.directory and core.hooksPath - in a global git config (GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL at /var/lib/devcontainer-features/git/gitconfig) kept in a named volume so identity and credential helper survive rebuilds.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

worktreeAware.description: Install the /usr/local/bin/git wrapper that unsets GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE when git runs inside a linked worktree or a nested repository (any directory whose nearest .git is not GIT_WORK_TREE). With false, no wrapper is installed and a previously installed one is removed.

safeDirectory.description: What git-setup marks as safe.directory in the global git config at post-create: 'workspace' = the workspace folder (its top level when mapped) and the git dir (GIT_DIR, or the one mapped from .git-dirs); '*' = every directory; empty = do nothing. Override per container with GIT_SETUP_SAFE_DIRECTORY in containerEnv.

hooksPath.description: When set, git-setup runs `git config core.hooksPath <value>` in the workspace repository at post-create (e.g. '.githooks'); empty leaves core.hooksPath alone. Override per container with GIT_SETUP_HOOKS_PATH in containerEnv.

commitName.description: Commit identity name for agents and bots. When commitEmail is set, the git wrapper exports GIT_AUTHOR_NAME and GIT_COMMITTER_NAME with this value (default: the email) for every git invocation that has not set them, so no repository-local or global user.name decides who commits. Empty with commitEmail empty = feature off.

commitEmail.description: Commit identity email (e.g. 'bot@noreply.invalid'). When set, the git wrapper exports GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL and GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL with this value for every git invocation that has not set them: environment variables beat every config level, including a repository-local user.email in a shared git dir, and `git commit -s` signs off with it. Installs the wrapper even with worktreeAware=false. Empty = identity left alone.

commitWhenEnv.description: Apply the commit identity only to git run with this environment variable set and non-empty, e.g. 'CLAUDECODE', which Claude Code sets on every process it starts (its tools, its subagents, headless runs): agents commit as commitName/commitEmail while a person's own terminal keeps their identity. Empty = the identity applies to every git invocation.
